title: When the agent actually gains Yoke context
situations: Yoke is installed during a live agent conversation
Human opens a harness after terminal setup
Another supported harness is installed later
Hooks, permissions or sign-in are incomplete
current: Observed campaign baseline verifies native harness requests as preparation. Current source adds complete approval-URI/code validation, late-harness configuration checks and a real receiving-context mission. Configuration and preparation remain distinct from live hook/orientation delivery proof. Outside-project global hook orientation, user-level yoke-global appearance and actual global receiving proof remain pending under YOK-3975; project-installed source cannot prove them.
questions: Which native files load at startup, on first tool use and after installation for each harness?
Are installation success, session registration and usable agent context separately proved?
Does each real supported surface load instructions and skill metadata mid-session versus only on restart?
Which otherwise supported feature refusals include the installed-release capability pointer?
